target_customer: Operations teams at local governments, law offices, insurance brokers, consulting firms and hedge funds that run repeatable browser based procedures (SOPs); later positioned toward healthcare workflow automation
problem: Staff spend hours repeating browser workflows. Altrina let a user demonstrate a workflow once and turned it into an editable browser automation.
business_model: B2B SaaS (browser automation platform); pricing not found
product_category: SOP and browser workflow automation, computer-use agents

founders.name: Mo Nasir
founders.background_notes: Named co-founder and CEO on the YC page and in the Abridge announcement.

founders.name: Harvey Hu
founders.background_notes: Author of the YC launch post. Founding engineer Karthik Prasad is named in the Abridge post but not as a co-founder.

exit.reason: Abridge announced on its blog that the Altrina team joined it; Altrina's site says the platform is no longer available. Terms were not disclosed.

technical_complexity.rationale: Recording a demonstration and compiling it into a robust, editable browser automation that survives page changes is standard LLM agent engineering with some hard parts; the founders came from NVIDIA, Google and TikTok ML roles.

defensibility.rationale: The YC launch post says every automation tool had been tried, and the category had many browser agent and recorder tools, so the product was easy for others to approximate. No data or network moat is described.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copying is documented. In July 2026 Abridge took on the team, reported as a team addition for browser based healthcare workflow expertise.

market_need_then: Repetitive manual browser work and the rise of LLM computer-use agents in 2024 and 2025 created demand for easier automation. The company's own pages cite efficiency gains at local governments, law offices, insurance brokers, consulting firms and hedge funds, with no numbers verified.

branding.domain_note: Site at altrina.com per YC listing; domain acquisition history not found.

identity.logo: New logo and typeface commissioned in a December 2025 rebrand, per a freelance designer's portfolio entry
identity.visual_style: not documented beyond the designer note
identity.voice_and_tone: plain, efficiency focused ('give humans back their time')

rebrands.why: not stated; the YC page lists the company as formerly General Agency/Tessa AI and the YC launch post for Tessa was a different positioning (universal BPO agent)

brand_strength.rationale: Two name changes within roughly a year, no press about the brand, and no community or merch found. Search results show similar names (Altr, Altera, Altris) which suggests confusability.

pivots.from: Tessa, a universal BPO agent that learns like a human (General Agency)
pivots.to: Altrina, an SOP automation platform that turns demonstrations into browser automations
pivots.why: not stated by the company; the YC launch post for Tessa and the Altrina launch post show the two positionings

outcome_analysis: Altrina entered YC in Winter 2025 as General Agency and Tessa AI, repositioned to an SOP automation product, and rebranded as Altrina in late 2025. It shows only a small pre-seed total in databases and no public customer metrics. In July 2026 the founders and a founding engineer joined Abridge, and the platform was shut down, which fits a soft landing where the team's browser agent and healthcare workflow skills were the asset rather than the standalone product.
notes: YC Inactive status reflects the 2026 acquihire by Abridge, so exit.type is acquisition. The pre-seed round rests on aggregator databases (VCBacked, PitchBook shows $500K total with an early stage VC entry dated 2025-03-13); one other directory dates it 2025-04. YC lists the company as Inactive while one search snippet showed Active, consistent with the acquihire. Competitors: the YC launch post and company site name none, and the only rival lists found were undated comparison directories, so the list is left empty. Education for both founders was not found. Founding year 2025 per YC, PitchBook says 2024.
